selected_evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backups from node2 to node1
selected_evidence.summary: The permanent 02:17 cron entry remains; crond automatically executed the workflow; the final dated archive is valid and a cross-node backup succeeded after both restarts.
A 4 KiB functional-test file had identical SHA-256 hashes in the source and archive.
The real backup workflow deleted an eight-day-old archive while retaining a six-day-old archive.

Host-key fingerprints matched, the private key is protected, and requesting `id` with the backup key returned only the forced archive stream. The final authorized-key constraints restrict source IP and command.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve operating-system release, kernel, packages, and security controls
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; no rsync or other package was installed; SELinux remains enforcing and only SSH listens.
Healthy baseline boot ID 2b19e976…; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 5967fb9a…; archive checksum persisted, services recovered, and a post-restart backup succeeded.
Healthy baseline boot ID 7217fc31…; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID d77f512f…; source/export state and services recovered, followed by a successful cross-node backup.
Test data, dummy archives, temporary schedule, and temporary archive residue were removed. Both systems report running with sshd and crond active and enabled.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- FINAL SERVICE/OS STATE ---'
. /etc/os-release
printf 'os=%s kernel=' "$PRETTY_NAME"; uname -r
systemctl is-system-running
systemctl is-active sshd crond
systemctl is-enabled sshd crond
rpm -q openssh-clients openssh-server cronie tar gzip
rpm -q rsync 2>/dev/null || echo 'rsync_not_installed_no_package_change'
printf '%s\n' '--- FINAL SOURCE/EXPORT STATE ---'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %a %n' /srv/inventory /srv/inventory/data /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-source /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
find /srv/inventory/data -xdev -printf '%y %M %u:%g %s %P\n' | sort
find /srv/inventory/data -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort
sha256sum /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-source
printf 'authorized_key_constraints='
awk '{print $1}' /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
sshd -t
getenforce
ss -tlnp
echo node2_final_healthy
